subject: CS363
filterSummary: Successfully selected 10 videos covering all 5 topics in both English and Arabic. The English selections are from highly reputable channels with massive view counts, ensuring top quality and relevance. For Arabic, selections were made from the best available academic and tutorial channels, with one selection requiring the low-view-count exception rule due to a lack of high-view, relevant content for the C++/RAII topic. The chosen videos provide a strong mix of theoretical lectures and practical demonstrations.

coverage.note: More relevant candidates [318, 319] failed the view count gate, leaving a more general but high-view video as the only eligible choice.
